The continuous variables without pre-constructed binary thresholds (age, pdl1_tps, ldh, weight_loss, hemoglobin, liver/renal panels, research signatures A/B/C) cannot be tested with the mean_difference framework.

**No validation request.** The 7 remaining validation requests have no eligible target: all four accepted claims are already validated with near-identical estimates (Δ≤0.003), and no other claim approaches the 10% clinical significance threshold (0.251 log-months). The next-largest effect after the four accepted findings is H12 (research_marker_d, 0.151 log-months, ~6% relative), which is 1.7× below the threshold and already rejected.

No further proposals scientifically justified. Investigation definitively complete.",
